display.purpose: Hero countdown/budget numbers, page and card headlines.

title.purpose: Card titles (15px) and compact names/headers in denser chrome (13px).

value.purpose: Compact numeric/currency displays in rows, chips, and stat blocks (16-20px).

label.purpose: Field labels, eyebrows, badges, nav sub-labels.

micro.purpose: Smallest eyebrow tier for compact stat labels and secondary metadata.

shadows.name: shadow-panel
shadows.purpose: Overlays above content: user menu, toast, bottom sheet.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for sheets, menus, and state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-commitment action on a screen (form submit, confirm/book).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; padding: 13px; background: #F5B536; color: #0D2340; border: none; border-radius: 11px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2A6FE0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Equal-weight alternate action alongside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { width: 100%; padding: 13px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #20242C; border: 1.5px solid rgba(13, 35, 64, 0.28); border-radius: 11px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #2A6FE0; background: rgba(42, 111, 224, 0.04); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2A6FE0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(13, 35, 64, 0.28); border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #20242C; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #2A6FE0; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(13, 35, 64, 0.42); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content card on the cream page ground.
components.html:
Trip Budget
$4,280 of $6,000 spent
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(13, 35, 64, 0.28); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-hdr { padding: 14px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(13, 35, 64, 0.1); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #20242C; } .ds-card-body { padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 14px; color: #20242C; }

components.name: Hero Panel
components.description: Solid navy 'ticket stamp' summary surface — countdown/budget hero on the dashboard.
components.css: .ds-hero { background: #0D2340; border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px 22px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-hero-lbl { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-hero-num { font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: 40px; line-height: 1; color: #F5B536; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status pill; semantic color only (teal/gold/coral).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-teal { background: rgba(44, 165, 141, 0.15); color: #1B7D68; } .ds-badge-gold { background: rgba(245, 181, 54, 0.2); color: #8a5a00; } .ds-badge-coral { background: rgba(224, 83, 63, 0.1); color: #E0533F; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Desktop drawer / row-style navigation item with active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; color: rgba(13, 35, 64, 0.6); text-decoration: none; border: none; background: none; width: 100%; text-align: left; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(42, 111, 224, 0.05); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: rgba(42, 111, 224, 0.08); } .ds-nav-item-active .ds-nav-label { color: #2A6FE0; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-label { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; flex: 1; }

components.name: Floating Action Button
components.description: Signature circular sky-blue add button, fixed bottom-right.
components.css: .ds-fab { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2A6FE0; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(42, 111, 224, 0.4); color: #fff; font-size: 23px; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-fab:hover { background: #1E5AC4; }

narrative.overview:
Parkday reads like a keepsake admission ticket, not a finance app. Warm cream paper stock, deep navy ink, and a gold-foil accent do the work that a typical fintech product would hand to sterile grays and a single saturated blue. A serif display face (Fraunces) supplies the confident, slightly formal "printed ticket" headline voice; Inter carries every working number, label, and control so the app still reads fast and legibly where it needs to be a tool, not a souvenir.

The system stays warm and reassuring on purpose: this app tracks families' vacation money, so its surfaces avoid anything cold, alarmist, or spreadsheet-like. Cards are soft-cornered and lightly lifted rather than bordered and flat; the one recurring "stamped" motif — a solid navy block used for hero/summary data (countdown, budget totals) — is the closest thing to a signature device, echoing a ticket's ink-stamped panel.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream paper background, never stark white as the page ground
Navy ink for headlines and the one deep "stamped" surface (hero blocks)
Gold as the primary call-to-action color; sky blue as the everyday interactive/link color
Coral and teal reserved for alert/success semantics only, never decoration
Fraunces serif for numbers and headlines that deserve weight; Inter for everything functional
Soft, generous corner radii and quiet shadows — depth is gentle, never dramatic

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Every border, secondary text tone, and shadow color derives from navy at reduced opacity — never introduce a neutral gray. Warmth comes from staying inside one hue family for "structure" colors.

rules.name: The Semantic-Only Rule
rules.body: Coral and teal appear only to mean something (error/urgent vs. success/positive). If a color choice is purely decorative, it must be sky, gold, or a neutral — never coral or teal.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-a-Number Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is reserved for headlines and quantities that deserve visual weight (dates, dollar amounts, page titles) — it never appears in body copy, buttons, or form fields.

rules.name: The Quiet Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are always soft, diffuse, and navy-tinted (never black) — depth should feel like paper lifted slightly off a table, not like a UI panel floating in space.

rules.name: The Icon Glyph Exception
rules.body: Icon font sizes follow their component's density and touch-target needs (roughly 11-20px), not the text type ramp — a tab-bar icon, a chevron, and a drag handle are sized to their own container, not to a paragraph's type scale.

dos: Do keep the page ground warm cream, never pure white or gray — white is reserved for cards/surfaces sitting on top of the page.
Do use gold only for the single primary/commitment action on a screen; a screen with two gold buttons has lost the ticket-stamp effect.
Do use Fraunces only for headlines and standalone numeric quantities, never for UI chrome, labels, or body copy.
Do derive borders and secondary text from navy at reduced opacity, keeping the whole neutral system warm.
Do keep shadows soft and navy-tinted; treat the flat/bordered look as the default and shadow as a rare accent.
donts: Don't use coral or teal decoratively — they carry error/urgent and success/positive meaning only.
Don't introduce a plain gray for borders, dividers, or muted text; use the navy-tint ladder instead.
Don't use Disney trademarks, character likenesses, or proprietary Disney marks/fonts anywhere in the visual system (product constraint, not a stylistic preference).

Don't treat the standalone HTML files in public/ (configurator, estimator, planner, pricing, account, home prototypes) as authoritative — they are earlier/exploratory iterations; the tokens and components above are extracted from the live src/ app.
